description.content: Get the account usage information between two dates. Note that the API response includes data from the start date while excluding data from the end date. In other words, the data covers the period starting from the specified start date up to, but not including, the end date.

query.description: (Required) Specify a `startDate` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. It should be before the `endDate`. The difference between `startDate` and `endDate` should be less than 90 days.
(Required) Specify a `endDate` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. It should be after the `startDate`. The difference between `startDate` and `endDate` should be less than 90 days.

response.name: In the response, you will get different usage metrics.
